# Prior shape of the posix-nonroot job: it started the test runner itself,
# outside with-temp-root, so nothing its cases left in the temp directory
# was ever seen.
name: posix-nonroot

jobs:
  suite:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm run build:packages
      - name: lock and io cases as a non-root user
        run: |
          node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern "76|80|81" \
            tests/trust-root-pass6.test.ts \
            tests/trust-root-pass7.test.ts
